ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Atmospheric Base
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
A framework that takes over the ambient light of a colony or a ship and animates it on behalf of other mods.
Select any lamp, wall light or floor light you own and press "Hand glow to Atmospheric Base". The framework then holds that fixture's glow. Press "Take glow back" and the fixture returns to exactly the colour it had before. Atmospheric Base never changes a light's radius, so other mods that dim lights keep working. Where a scenario decides for a map, the buttons are hidden and the scenario hands lights over itself.
What it will never touch, whatever is asking: glowing animals and other pawns, worn or carried gear, plants, and holograms. Lights are found by what they can do (a building with a glow), never by a list of known lamps, so any lighting mod that uses the game's own glow works.
Lights you hand over show a mood. With nothing else setting one, a gentle default runs: Lamplight, where each room breathes slowly through three warm levels on its own clock, all bright enough to work under. A mood only ever steps between a few fixed colours, never a smooth fade, and only a light whose colour actually changes is touched, so it stays cheap with hundreds of lights. An unpowered light is left alone. It keeps running while the game is paused. Other mods can set a mood on the whole colony, on rooms, halls or outdoors, or on a group of lights they name.
No Harmony and no change to any game or mod definition. With nothing handed over, the colony is lit exactly as it would be without this mod. Mod Settings: the light channel, the hand-over buttons, animation on or off, the default mood on or off, and where the default runs.
Later releases add territory between two moods, gestures and the sound channel.
